about: Modwerk source-only live-rec-retrig-fix package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/live-rec-retrig-fix.

mods.title: Live Rec Retrig Fix
mods.summary: LIVE RECORDING records every pad retrig hit as a real trig, with the velocity and timing you played.
mods.description: LIVE RECORDING records every pad retrig hit as a real trig, with the velocity and timing you played.

mods.on_unit: The author's builds RC07 to RC11 and LD01 ran this code on an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 beside other modules, as reported; this package links to the same image as its source build LR20 but has not run on a unit.
